name: Azure CLI (az) setup
description: Brings in the Azure CLI through dependsOn on ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/azure-cli (with installBicep, from Microsoft's signed apt repository) and augments it: owns the login state as a named volume at AZURE_CONFIG_DIR=/var/lib/devcontainer-features/az so `az login` survives rebuilds, and adds a post-create hook (az-setup) that makes that directory usable by the remote user, tells az to use a bicep binary found on PATH (so `az bicep` does not download its own), and reports the az version and whether a login is present. Plus the Feature Taskfile.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).

bicepFromPath.description: At post-create, when a bicep binary is on PATH (the azure-cli Feature's installBicep puts one there), set `az config set bicep.use_binary_from_path=true` so `az bicep` and `az deployment` use it instead of asking to install their own copy. Override per container with AZ_SETUP_BICEP_FROM_PATH in containerEnv.
